name: Russolutions
description: Three tools in one panel: fill any form from a list, reshape a table you pasted, and rewrite a block of text.
//offscreen: Reshape's Local OCR. Tesseract needs a Worker and WebAssembly, and the panel is a content script in somebody else's page, where it can have neither under the extension's rules. background.js makes ONE offscreen document (ocr/offscreen.html) on the first local read and sends each picture there. It adds no host and reads no page; the picture stays on this machine.
//content_security_policy: The MV3 default for extension pages, plus 'wasm-unsafe-eval' — which lets the BUNDLED Tesseract core (ocr/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js) compile its WebAssembly. It does not allow string eval or remote script: 'self' is still the only script source.
//options_ui: The API key is entered HERE, not in the panel. The panel is injected into the visited page's DOM, where a password input is a node any script on that page can read; an options page is an extension-origin document the site cannot touch. open_in_tab so it is a real page with a URL, not a dialog that vanishes on a stray click while a key is half-pasted.

_execute_action.description: Open or close the Russolutions panel on this page
